title: Edgware Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and supply points for Edgware, Burnt Oak, and Canons Park.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-hour A&E Hospitals:
- Barnet Hospital: Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. Full 24-hour A&E. From Edgware Station: ~4.5 miles northeast via A410 / A1 / Wood Street, or bus 107 direct to Barnet Hospital.
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. 24-hour A&E and acute trauma services. From Canons Park Station: ~4 miles southwest via A4140 / Watford Road, or bus 186 / 79 towards Harrow.
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. 24-hour A&E reachable south down the A41 / Northern line.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Edgware Community Hospital Walk-in Centre: Burnt Oak Broadway, Edgware HA8 0AD. From Burnt Oak Station: ~8 min walk north along Burnt Oak Broadway (~0.4 miles). From Edgware Station: ~15 min walk south along High Street / Burnt Oak Broadway (~0.8 miles), or bus 32 / 142 / 288.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The Silk Stream and Edgware Brook converge near Edgware and Burnt Oak; heavy rain creates surface flooding risks across low points on the A5 corridor and local rail underpasses.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies, chemists, and large supermarkets along Edgware Station Road, Broadwalk Shopping Centre, and Burnt Oak Broadway provide clean water, sanitary items, first-aid equipment, and medications.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
